production.confirmedBy: Guides owner, by delegated judgement on 2026-10-19 ("As for the prod release you can make that judgement")
production.confirmation: Confirmed as production on the evidence below plus two further facts: it is the newest Deployments/release/* branch, its own history includes 2503d032 'Hide non production widgets: Decision Tree, DTN Weather, Weather Averages', which develop does not have and which only makes sense on a production snapshot, and the newest Deployments/beta/* branch sits exactly on develop (see beta), so develop is what the beta environment runs, not production. Re-check if a newer Deployments/release/* branch appears.
production.method: IntelliDash documents its own release convention at this SHA: CONTRIBUTING.md:26 describes Deployments/release/{YYMMDD}_{slug} as the snapshot deployed to production, CONTRIBUTING.md:44 says production ships from Deployments/release/* and not from master, and CONTRIBUTING.md:47-48 says the repository has no tags, so a release is identified by its Deployments/release/* branch name and the version in site/package.json. After the fetch there are 11 Deployments/release/* branches and no tags. This is the newest of them by both its YYMMDD name and its committer date, and its site/package.json:3 version (2.5.261015) is the highest of any ref inspected. The repository cannot prove it is what is deployed now: docs/guides/deployment.md:77 says nothing in the repository describes how production is published. Recorded first as the best candidate, then confirmed (see confirmation).

rejected.reason: Last committed in 2023. CONTRIBUTING.md:41-45 at the production SHA states master is not the release branch in current practice.
Older release/ naming that CONTRIBUTING.md:36 lists as a deviation from the current Deployments/release/* shape, and a year older than the newest Deployments/release/* branch.

beta.note: The newest Deployments/beta/* branch, at the same SHA as develop. Content that exists on develop/beta but not on production is beta content, handled by the beta-content switch.
